title: SKE Crystal Lemon Peach Passionfruit Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: SKE Crystal Lemon Peach Passionfruit Nic Salt delivers a bright, tropical trio of fruit flavours. Sharp Lemon kicks things off with a citrusy tang, followed by the mellow sweetness of sun-ripened Peach. On the exhale, Passionfruit adds a tropical twist with its distinctive aromatic depth, tying the blend together with a subtly exotic finish. Each fruit brings something different to the mix zest, sweetness, and depth creating a layered flavour that's both refreshing and moreish. It's a vibrant all-day vape for those who enjoy complex fruit combinations with a clean, satisfying profile. This 50VG/50PG nicotine salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it delivers a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine delivery. About SKE Crystal SKE is renowned for delivering bold, satisfying flavours with sleek, user-friendly design. Their Crystal Bar disposables helped set a new standard for flavour clarity and convenience, and the SKE Crystal Nic Salt range continues that legacy offering the same popular flavours in a format compatible with a wide range of refillable pod kits and MTL vape devices. With a presence in over 50 countries, SKE remains at the forefront of vaping innovation.
